d:
Bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri munger jile ke kalyanpur sthit prasiddh man bari durga maharani mandir pahunche, jahan unhonne vidhi-vidhan se puja-archana kar rajy ki khushhali aur samriddhi ki kamna ki.
Is avsar par aayojit bhavy evan aitihasik dipotsav karyakram men mukhyamantri shamil hue. kalyanpur mandir parisar 11,11,111 (11 lakh 11 hajar 111) mitti ke diyon ki alaukik roshni se jagamga utha. is adbhut najare ko dekhne ke lie shraddhaluon aur sthaniy logon ka bhari jansailab umar para.
